CEYLON ELECTRICITY BOARD ACT, NO. 17 OF 1969
Order under Section 57

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 57 of Ceylon Electricity Board Act, No. 17 of 1969, I, Ranjith Siyambalapitiya,Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, do by this order, approve the proposed acquisition of lands required by theCeylon Electricity Board and described in the Schedule hereto.
RANJITH SIYAMBALAPITIYA,Minister of Power and Renewable Energy.
16 th March 2016 .

The lands situated in the village of Kalukohuthenna in Grama Niladari's Division of No. 134 D, Kalukohuthenna in theDivisional Secretary's Division of Yatiyantota at Dehigampala Korale, in the Administrative District of Kegalle in the Provinceof Sabaragamuwa of Sri Lanka containing in extents of 0.1265 (50 Perches) Hectares shown in Draft Plan No. BHP 001 dated26.02.2016, depicted as Block No. 01 and 0.5691 (l Acre, 1 Rood and 25 Perches) Hectares shown in Draft Plan No. BHP 002dated 26.02.2016, depicted as Block No. 02 prepared by Ceylon Electricity Board and bounded as follows :

01.Block No. 01 - Land in extent of 0.1265 Hectares (50 Perches) with permanent buildingNorth:Avissawella - Hatton main road ;East:Not relevant ;South:Road to Pokunawala village ;West:Not relevant.Claimed by:unknown.
02.Block No. 02 - Land in extent of 0.5691 Hectares (l Acre, I Rood and 25 Perches)North: Gamsabha Road;East:Kelani River ;South:Kelani River ;West:Gamsabha RoadClaimed by:unknown.
